item.text: I’ve got the implementation shape pinned down. The Rust entrypoint is going to write raw bytes to stdout instead of relying on UTF-8 `println!`, because the C++ decoder can legally emit arbitrary bytes from `%HH` sequences and I want the output to stay byte-exact.

It builds successfully with both `rustc --edition=2021 test17.rs` and `cargo build --release`. The executables are at [test17](/output/test17) and [test17](/output/target/release/test17). I also ran `cargo test` and byte-compared the Rust program against `/workspace/dataset/test17_executable` on representative inputs including empty strings, spaces, reserved characters, malformed escapes, UTF-8 text, and raw-byte cases like `%ff`.
